summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed Form 6-K attaching an ASX announcement that it broke ground on the fully funded North American Lithium expansion project, along with an Appendix 3G notice of issue, conversion or payment up of unquoted equity securities. The filing describes a milestone in a capital project, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC matter, or forced management change. The equity issuance notice is routine and relates to previously announced capital raising.
